baskets.name: Pure Silicon
baskets.description: Semiconductors are the foundational hardware behind every device, model, and machine, and demand continues to climb as computing spreads into more of the economy. This portfolio concentrates on the chip industry itself: the designers, the memory makers, the foundries that manufacture wafers, and the equipment companies that supply the production lines.

baskets.name: Leopold Aschenbrenner Tracker
baskets.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner is a former OpenAI researcher who went viral in 2024 with his essay series Situational Awareness, arguing that artificial general intelligence is arriving sooner than almost anyone expects and that the economic consequences will be staggering. He went on to launch Situational Awareness LP, an investment fund built around that idea. This portfolio is inspired by and tracks the long positions disclosed by Situational Awareness LP in public SEC filings.

baskets.name: Digital Fortress
baskets.description: Every new connected device and AI system adds another target to defend, and cybersecurity spending continues to climb as a result. This portfolio holds the platforms and infrastructure protecting the digital world, from endpoint and network security to cloud and identity.

baskets.name: Nancy Pelosi Tracker
baskets.description: Nancy Pelosi, the former Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives, is among the most closely watched names in the market, with the trades disclosed in her congressional filings drawing intense public attention for their strong reported performance. The activity is concentrated in large-cap technology and AI companies, and has become a widely followed signal among retail investors who track congressional disclosures. This portfolio is inspired by and tracks the positions disclosed in Nancy Pelosi's congressional financial filings, with options converted into their underlying stock equivalents.

baskets.name: The Compute Grab
baskets.description: Cheap power and available land have become the scarcest resources of the AI era, and a wave of operators are racing to convert both into data center capacity. This portfolio holds the infrastructure companies, cloud providers, and former crypto miners pivoting to high-performance computing, alongside the power producers supplying them.

baskets.name: Black Gold
baskets.description: Oil remains central to the global economy, and the companies that produce, refine, and transport it generate some of the largest cash flows in the market. This portfolio holds the integrated majors, independent producers, and oilfield service providers that benefit when energy prices rise.

baskets.name: Energy Infrastructure
baskets.description: Electricity demand is rising sharply as AI data centers, electric vehicles, and reshored manufacturing all draw more power from the grid. This portfolio holds the utilities, equipment manufacturers, and storage providers building the capacity to meet it.

baskets.name: Hard Money
baskets.description: Precious metals and bitcoin have historically held their value when currencies weaken and inflation runs high. This portfolio holds physical gold and silver alongside smaller allocations to platinum and bitcoin, combining the oldest stores of value with the newest.

holdings.name: abrdn Physical Platinum Shares ETF (Ondo Tokenized)

baskets.name: Mine The Future
baskets.description: Robots, chips, electric vehicles, and weapons all begin as raw materials pulled from the ground. This portfolio holds the miners and processors supplying the critical metals and minerals behind the industrial economy, including rare earths, copper, lithium, and uranium.

baskets.name: Warren Buffett Tracker
baskets.description: Warren Buffett built Berkshire Hathaway into one of the most successful investment companies in history, turning a struggling textile maker into a conglomerate worth hundreds of billions through a patient, value-focused approach to owning great businesses. His portfolio is among the most closely watched in the world, known for concentrated, long-term bets on durable, cash-generating companies. This portfolio is inspired by and tracks the equity positions disclosed by Berkshire Hathaway in its public SEC filings.

baskets.name: AI Full Stack
baskets.description: The artificial intelligence build-out runs across several industries at once: the chips that train models, the servers and networking that run them, the cloud platforms that rent out capacity, and the power generation feeding the data centers. This portfolio holds a position in every layer rather than concentrating on a single winner.

baskets.name: The Healthcare Trade
baskets.description: A new class of blockbuster drugs is reshaping healthcare and creating some of the most valuable companies in medicine. This portfolio anchors on the leaders behind that breakthrough and broadens into large pharmaceutical makers, medical device companies, and biotech.

baskets.name: The Magnificent Seven Portfolio (+10%)
baskets.description:
The Magnificent Seven, the companies behind most of the US market's growth this past decade, in a single portfolio.

Unlike your normal Mag7 ETF, this one earns an additional 10% on top. The 10% accrues automatically to your portfolio.

baskets.name: Cathie Wood Tracker
baskets.description: Cathie Wood is the founder and chief investment officer of ARK Invest, and one of the most closely followed investors in the world, known for high-conviction bets on disruptive innovation across artificial intelligence, crypto, robotics, and genomics. Her flagship ARK Innovation strategy is recognised for concentrated positions in fast-growing technology companies positioned to benefit from major technological shifts. This portfolio is inspired by and tracks the equity positions disclosed in ARK Invest's publicly published holdings.

baskets.name: The Arsenal
baskets.description: Defense budgets are rising worldwide, and the nature of warfare is shifting toward software, drones, and autonomous systems. This portfolio pairs the established defense primes with the newer technology companies reshaping the battlefield.

baskets.name: Quantum
baskets.description: Quantum computing aims to solve problems that classical machines cannot, and the market is only beginning to price in its long-term potential. This portfolio pairs the large technology companies funding quantum research with the smaller pure-play developers building the hardware.

baskets.name: Neo Finance
baskets.description: Financial services are shifting away from traditional banks toward digital platforms, payment networks, and crypto-native businesses. This portfolio combines the established card networks that process most global transactions with the trading apps, neobanks, and stablecoin issuers competing to replace them.

baskets.name: Consumer Brands
baskets.description: Consumer brands are the companies people interact with daily through what they stream, eat, wear, and buy on repeat. This portfolio holds established businesses with strong pricing power, loyal customers, and long records of steady growth.

baskets.name: Road Warriors
baskets.description: The automobile is being reinvented twice over, first as electric and then as autonomous. This portfolio holds the manufacturers, ride-hailing platforms, and self-driving software companies competing to define how people and goods move next.

baskets.name: Escape Velocity
baskets.description: Space has shifted from a government program to a genuine commercial industry, with launch, satellites, and orbital services now generating real revenue. This portfolio holds the rocket builders, satellite operators, and space infrastructure companies developing the economy above the atmosphere.

baskets.name: Going Nuclear
baskets.description: Nuclear power is returning to favor after decades on the sidelines, driven by the need for constant, carbon-free electricity to run AI data centers. This portfolio combines the utilities operating today's reactors with the small modular reactor developers and uranium miners positioned for the next wave.
